title: Acme Textiles — MFA registration ≠ enforcement
description: Acme claims MFA is enforced for all 20 privileged accounts, but only submits a registration report covering 17 users. Registration does not prove enforcement.

evidence.description: MFA Registration Report — HR & IT dept (Sept 2026)

title: Bravo Corp — No evidence submitted
description: Bravo Corp claims endpoint protection is enabled on all 50 workstations but submits no supporting documents.

title: Charlie Inc — Incomplete backup coverage
description: Charlie claims all 12 production servers have tested backups, but the audit report only covers 8 servers.

evidence.description: Quarterly Backup Test Report — Prod Servers (June 2026)

title: Delta Ltd — Full MFA enforcement confirmed
description: Delta claims MFA is enforced for all 15 privileged accounts. Evidence is an enforcement log covering all 15, dated before policy signing.

title: Echo Co — Endpoint protection explicitly disabled
description: Echo Co claims endpoint protection is enabled, but the submitted security audit log shows AV was disabled on all workstations during the policy period.

evidence.description: Security Audit Log — AV disabled on all endpoints (Aug 2026)

title: Foxtrot LLC — Evidence dated after policy signing
description: Foxtrot submits a valid MFA enforcement log, but it is dated two weeks after the policy signing date and therefore cannot be admitted as pre-signing evidence.
